requirements.text: The catalogue lists products cheapest first
The catalogue shows every product, including ones that are out of stock
The cart subtotal equals the sum of the line totals
A valid discount code reduces the subtotal by the advertised percentage
Tax is 8.5% of the subtotal after discount
The cart total is the discounted subtotal plus tax
The cart total is the same on the cart page and the checkout page
The checkout page shows a confirmation message and an order id
Applying a valid discount code shows no error message
Orders over $50 ship free and the page says so
The checkout action stays blocked until the cart is valid
An out-of-stock product cannot be added to the cart
A returning customer sees their previous orders
